ac81_sentence.text: **Two-file state:** `manifest.json` is the run record from bim001 onward; `run_summary.json` is the frozen bim000 contract retained for compatibility and queued for retirement in a later module (bim004 or later). Until then both are written on every run, with identical `started_at` / `finished_at` and identical per-page `url/status/ok/elapsed_s/error` values.
